basis_truncation.disclosure: basis beyond the measured no-move range (r 0.15; range to 0.129): whether the served crossings moved is measured at this set's re-fit
basis_truncation.disclosure_rule: a served fit's basis is adequate when its re-fit at the ruled basis moves none of the served crossings beyond the run-to-run noise floor (measured no-move range); the 1% design criterion applies to new cuts only
basis_truncation.rule: design rule for new cuts: adequate iff r(min ell) <= 1e-2, r = exp(-1/4(ell w_M)^2)/exp(-1/4(ell w_1)^2), w_j = j*pi/(2L); served fits are judged by the measured no-move range (see the disclosure rule)

waves._basis: LABEL COUNT = the set as it appears on the approved surfaces, as changed only by the owner's rulings (the 9 Sep HumanEval/132 ruling moved wave 1 from 432 to its present count): each wave's label is its count field in this file (count_key names the field). wave 1 = the board's graded set with a valid label (original_kept; the label-excluded originals were never board tasks on the approved surfaces), wave 2 = the frozen focus membership after the twin fold (new_focused), wave 2 parked = new_parked, wave 1+2 = original_kept + new_focused. Qualifiers beside every wave: kept_count (tasks with a valid label) and members (every admitted task) — both computed here, never typed. Pages that do not draw their label from this file name their own basis in their notes: a fitted figure names the fit frame from fitting's served stamp (following at each re-cut); a census of all runs names members. Basis settled with pool-pages-lead on 2026-09-08 against the approved surfaces (RULINGS.md WAVE LABEL BASIS SETTLED); the kept-everywhere word of that evening is withdrawn (no ruling behind it); re-decided 2026-09-10 under cleanup F1a-24 (RULINGS.md COUNT OF RECORD BASIS): the fields are the single source, the prose carries no typed count.
